idempotent-ledger.name: Ledger.java
idempotent-ledger.content: public class Ledger {private int balance;private final java.util.Map<String,Receipt> seen=new java.util.HashMap<>();public String apply(String id,int amount){if(amount<0)return "INVALID";Receipt old=seen.get(id);if(old!=null)return old.amount()==amount?String.valueOf(old.balanceAfter()):"CONFLICT";balance+=amount;seen.put(id,new Receipt(amount,balance));return String.valueOf(balance);}}

map-merge-reports.name: Main.java
map-merge-reports.content: public class Main {public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{var in=new java.util.Scanner(System.in);var a=new java.util.HashMap<String,Integer>();var b=new java.util.HashMap<String,Integer>();int n=in.nextInt();for(int i=0;i<n;i++)a.put(in.next(),in.nextInt());int m=in.nextInt();for(int i=0;i<m;i++)b.put(in.next(),in.nextInt());Merger.combine(a,b).forEach((k,v)->System.out.println(k+":"+v));}}

map-merge-reports.name: Merger.java
map-merge-reports.content: public class Merger {public static java.util.Map<String,Integer> combine(java.util.Map<String,Integer> a,java.util.Map<String,Integer> b){var result=new java.util.TreeMap<String,Integer>(a);b.forEach((k,v)->result.merge(k,v,Integer::sum));return result;}}

atomic-reservation.name: Main.java
atomic-reservation.content: public class Main {public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{var in=new java.util.Scanner(System.in);StockCounter c=new StockCounter(in.nextInt());var barrier=new java.util.concurrent.CyclicBarrier(2);var accepted=new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger();Runnable task=()->{int seen=c.remaining();try{barrier.await();}catch(Exception e){throw new RuntimeException(e);}if(c.reserve(seen))accepted.incrementAndGet();};Thread a=new Thread(task),b=new Thread(task);a.start();b.start();a.join();b.join();System.out.println(accepted.get()+" "+c.remaining());}}

atomic-reservation.name: StockCounter.java
atomic-reservation.content: public class StockCounter {private final java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger stock;public StockCounter(int n){stock=new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger(n);}public int remaining(){return stock.get();}public boolean reserve(int expected){return expected>0&&stock.compareAndSet(expected,expected-1);}}
